lead.question: 休列了满满一张禁食清单，为何一周后依然胖得像从前一样？
lead.warmup: 你是否也为减重立过一张禁吃清单，却在几天后偷偷撕毁？本课里的休正是如此：他一直很胖，近来情况糟糕到不得不节食，于是认真开出长长一张禁食单——黄油、土豆、米饭、啤酒、牛奶、巧克力、糖果。一周后朋友登门拜访，却发现他依旧胖如往常，桌下还藏着一个大包裹……
goals: 掌握 so…that 结果状语从句，以及 go on a diet、first of all、pay sb a visit 等核心短语
辨析 contain 与 include 的差异
理解 hurriedly、guiltily 等形容词+ly 副词的构词与作用
复习一般过去时与过去完成时，能用 It was obvious that 改写句子
lead.summary: 休一直很胖，近来情况越发糟糕，一周前他决定节食：首先开出长长一张禁食清单，上面几乎全是他最爱吃的东西。昨天我去看他，他仍和往常一样胖，还慌忙把大包裹藏到桌下，显得十分尴尬；被问起时才内疚地笑着坦白：饮食控制太严格，只好偶尔奖赏自己——五大块巧克力和三袋糖果。
lead.tips: 复述时用 got—decided—began—wrote out—paid—rang—led—hid—smiled—explained 串起情节；reward 是及物动词，说 reward himself，因某事奖赏才用 reward sb for sth。

questions.q: Why did Hugh's diet not work?
questions.zh: 为什么休的节食没有起作用？
questions.a: Because his diet was so strict that he had to reward himself occasionally: he ate the very foods on his forbidden list — five large bars of chocolate and three bags of sweets.
questions.aZh: 因为他的饮食控制得太严格，他不得不偶尔奖赏自己，吃的恰恰是禁食单上的东西——5 大块巧克力和 3 袋糖果。
questions.hint: his diet was so strict that he had to reward himself occasionally…

questions.q: What did Hugh do first of all when he began his diet?
questions.zh: 休开始节食时做的第一件事是什么？
questions.a: First of all, he wrote out a long list of all the foods which were forbidden.
questions.aZh: 首先，他开出一张长长的单子，上面列了所有禁吃的食物。
questions.hint: First of all, he wrote out a long list…

questions.q: Why was the writer not surprised to see Hugh?
questions.zh: 为什么作者看到休时并不感到惊奇？
questions.a: Because Hugh was still as fat as ever after only a week of dieting.
questions.aZh: 因为节食才一周，休仍和往常一样胖。

questions.q: How did Hugh behave when the writer came into his room?
questions.zh: 作者进屋时休有哪些举动？
questions.a: He hurriedly hid a large parcel under his desk, was obviously embarrassed, then smiled guiltily and put the parcel on the desk.
questions.aZh: 他慌忙把大包裹藏到桌下，显得很尴尬，随后内疚地笑了笑，把包裹放到了桌上。
questions.hint: hurriedly hid、It was obvious that he was very embarrassed、smiled guiltily。

questions.q: 休把偷吃巧克力说成“对美德的奖赏”，你怎么看？标题的讽刺在哪里？
questions.a: It is ironic: his only 'virtue' is one week of dieting, and his 'reward' is exactly the forbidden food that ruins the diet.
questions.aZh: 这是一种反讽：所谓美德不过一周节食，而奖赏恰恰是毁掉节食的禁吃食品。
questions.hint: 把写禁食单、一周后仍 as fat as ever、reward himself occasionally 连起来体会。

exercises.q: 用括号内动词的适当形式填空：Before I paid him a visit, he ______ already ______ (write) out a long list of foods.
exercises.note: 过去完成时表过去的过去。

exercises.q: 填空：Things got ______ bad recently ______ he decided to go ______ a diet.
用所给词的适当形式填空：He ______ (hurried) hid a large parcel under his desk and smiled ______ (guilty).
exercises.note: 形容词加 -ly 构成方式副词。

exercises.q: 汉译英：首先，他开出一张长长的单子，上面列了所有禁吃的食物。
exercises.a: First of all, he wrote out a long list of all the foods which were forbidden.

exercises.q: 汉译英：昨天我去看望了他。
exercises.a: Yesterday I paid him a visit.
exercises.note: pay sb a visit 拜访某人。

exercises.q: 用 It was obvious that 开头改写：He was very embarrassed.
exercises.a: It was obvious that he was very embarrassed.

exercises.q: 汉译英：他解释说，他的饮食控制得太严格了，以致不得不偶尔奖赏自己一下。
exercises.a: He explained that his diet was so strict that he had to reward himself occasionally.
exercises.note: reward sb for sth 因某事奖赏某人。

quiz.q: 休一周前开始节食后，做的第一件事是什么？
options: He wrote out a long list of all the foods which were forbidden.
He paid a visit to his friend for advice.
He bought five large bars of chocolate.
He rang the bell and hid a large parcel.
quiz.note: First of all, he wrote out a long list…

quiz.q: 休藏在桌下的那个大包裹里装的是什么？
options: Five large bars of chocolate and three bags of sweets!
A long list of all the forbidden foods.
Butter, potatoes, rice and beer.
A bottle of milk and some chocolate.
quiz.note: It contained five large bars of chocolate and three bags of sweets!

quiz.q: The parcel ______ five large bars of chocolate and three bags of sweets. 横线上应填？
options: contained
was including
includes
has been contained
quiz.note: contain 表容器内全部所装之物。

quiz.q: 下列哪一句正确使用了 forbid 的搭配？
options: His mother forbade him to eat chocolate.
His mother forbade him eating chocolate.
His mother forbade him eat chocolate.
His mother forbade that he eats chocolate.

quiz.q: Yesterday I paid him a visit. 可以改写为下列哪一句？
options: Yesterday I paid a visit to him.
Yesterday I paid visit him.
Yesterday I made him a visit to.
Yesterday I visited to him.
quiz.note: pay sb a visit = pay a visit to sb。

quiz.q: 标题 Reward for Virtue 中的 virtue 最接近哪个英文释义？
options: a good moral quality or good behaviour
a kind of sweet food like chocolate
a strict plan for losing weight
a large parcel hidden under the desk
